reason: B proposes the more physically established and directly testable rate–temperature transition from dislocation slip to twinning, with controlled specimens, measurable twin density and mechanical responses, and a clear falsification criterion. A overextends evidence from compositionally different alloys into an unsupported FCC→HCP threshold mechanism, introduces unjustified numerical predictions, and relies on experimentally problematic in situ defect-density measurements during Hopkinson-bar loading.
